evidence.review_scope: non-powered FR-017 forearm cuff physical-validation evidence review only

field_contract.evidence_date: Use an ISO 8601 calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format for evidence.date. Future-dated engineering-review evidence is invalid because it cannot be completed evidence.
field_contract.placeholder_values: Placeholder text such as PENDING is treated as missing evidence case-insensitively and after trimming. Lowercase, padded, or whitespace-only placeholders cannot satisfy required FR-017 engineering-review fields.
field_contract.pilot_identity_linkage: evidence.pilot_id must match evidence.pilot_id in the linked quick-release/cable-snag record. Do not use engineering-review evidence for one pilot with release/cable evidence collected from another pilot.
field_contract.evidence_chronology: Engineering-review evidence.date must be the same as or later than the linked quick-release/cable-snag evidence.date. Do not fabricate or backdate engineering-review evidence before release/cable evidence exists.
field_contract.required_pass_checks: Use unquoted JSON boolean true only when the review item is directly verified and accepted. Use false for verified rejection or unmet criteria; false blocks progression.
field_contract.required_false_checks: Use unquoted JSON boolean false only when the prohibited clearance or redesign condition is not present. Use true when present; true blocks progression. Do not use yes/no/1/0 or quoted true/false strings.
field_contract.record_linkage: evidence.quick_release_cable_snag_record_path must resolve to the same quick-release/cable-snag record path passed into scripts/fr017-engineering-review-gate.ps1. Stale, copied, or unrelated release/cable evidence blocks progression.
field_contract.review_scope: evidence.review_scope must remain exactly "non-powered FR-017 forearm cuff physical-validation evidence review only". Broader powered, load-bearing, frame-coupled, FR-018, or general exosystem review scope is invalid for this gate.
